verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is indirect. A community user describes using TeamViewer to log into Windows and launch Steam on a remote gaming PC, which implies their keyboard and mouse input reaches the host. The vendor's remote-support positioning ('Fix issues remotely') points the same way, but neither source documents how input is injected. Missing for 10: documentation of mouse/keyboard/scroll forwarding as native host events, scroll and modifier/shortcut handling, and independent hands-on verification of input fidelity.
